topic: Day 65 — reel — Resilient people just have more reps at breaking and recovering
text:
Resilience is a
[callus], not a
personality trait.
caption:
Nobody is born with it. It gets built by surviving things repeatedly, which means it's available to anyone who has had a hard enough year.

Follow for one of these a day.
